title: MatrixContainer
author: JG
description: consider functionality to link to dense numpy matrix; possibly by using the allocatedSize in ResizableMatrix to indicate linking rather than allocation
releaseNotes: A numpy matrix returned by a Python user function (mass matrix, Jacobian) is copied once into the item's matrix, which keeps its memory, instead of twice; ObjectGenericODE2 with a 6 x 6 mass matrix user function solves in 0.88 of the time of 1.13.6.
